source.title: Cefazolin Dialytic Clearance by High-Efficiency and High-Flux Hemodialyzers
source.erratum: American Journal of Kidney Diseases. 2001;37(5):1111. DOI 10.1016/S0272-6386(05)80037-X.

extraction_metadata.scope_note: Primary study methods, central pharmacokinetic results, dosing simulations, reported safety, author conclusions, funding, and the appended erratum were atomized. Bibliography entries were not treated as evidence atoms.

atoms.canonical_statement: The study aimed to characterize cefazolin pharmacokinetics and dialytic clearance with high-efficiency and high-flux hemodialyzers.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The purpose of this study is two fold: (1) to characterize the pharmacokinetics and dialytic clearance of cefazolin

atoms.canonical_statement: The study also aimed to develop clinical cefazolin dosing strategies for patients receiving high-permeability hemodialysis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: and (2) to develop clinical dosing strategies for cefazolin dosing in patients undergoing dialysis with high-permeability hemodialyzers.

atoms.canonical_statement: Twenty-five subjects were recruited from three outpatient dialysis centers and all were uninfected patients with end-stage renal disease receiving chronic thrice-weekly hemodialysis.
